verdict.rationale: Retell's docs clearly describe per-agent data retention configuration that auto-deletes call/chat transcripts, recordings, and logs after a set period (retell-docs-15, 27, 44), giving users control over that data lifecycle. However, a concrete community report describes Retell refusing to delete a user's stored credit card data despite requests, forcing escalation to bank disputes/BBB complaints (retell-comm-14) — a documented case where deletion control did not work as expected for account/payment data. Missing for 10: evidence of full account-level (not just call/chat) deletion controls, resolution of the credit-card deletion complaint, and independent confirmation of compliance with retention policies.
